title: CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to a proposed 10-year lease with Joby Aero Inc. for the use and…
text:
[Council File 26-1478; CD 6]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to a proposed 10-year lease with Joby Aero Inc. for the use and development of aviation land and building space at Van Nuys Airport.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' action on September 23, 2026, in finding that the proposed lease is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article III, Class 1(18)(c) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Board of Airport Commissioners Resolution No. 28481 authorizing a 10-year lease with Joby Aero Inc. for the use and development of aviation land and building space at 7646 Hayvenhurst Avenue at Van Nuys Airport.
3. CONCUR with the action taken by the Board of Airport Commissioners on September 23, 2026, by Resolution No. 28481, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, Los Angeles World Airports, to execute said lease, subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that the proposed lease will generate approximately $1,750,000 in revenue over the 10-year term. There is no impact to the General Fund. The City Administrative Officer and Chief Legislative Analyst have not completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Trade, Travel and Tourism Committee waived consideration of the above matter)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 14, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 13, 2026
